propositions: compact.py is 798 LOC and bundles three responsibilities (compaction transaction, snapshot reconstruction, CLI) with high cyclomatic complexity, blocking bug aea0 and flagged by audit ae1b

The refactor extracts _compact_locked and related snapshot primitives into compact_txn.py, rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log into compact_rebuild.py, and retains a thin CLI facade in compact.py with re-exports to preserve public import paths
Shared snapshot primitives (_build_authorship_ledger, _snapshot_strip_keys, _git_author, _git) must live in compact_txn to avoid circular imports between compact_txn and compact_rebuild

The module-level counter _REBUILD_COUNT and get_rebuild_count must co-locate in compact_rebuild because rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log does global _REBUILD_COUNT; leaving get_rebuild_count in compact.py would read a different module global
Two test monkeypatch seams in test_compact_negative.py must be repointed from the facade module to compact_txn because _compact_locked now reads compact_txn's globals

Acceptance criteria require compact.py <= 500 LOC, both new modules >= 100 LOC, complexity baseline entries shrunk or removed, all public symbols re-exported and resolvable through rebar._commands.compact, counter co-location proven by test, and full suite green
